question: SPIQA 从多少篇论文收集了多少个 figure 和多少个 table？
ground_truth: 25,859 篇论文、152,487 个 figure 和 117,707 个 table。
contexts: SPIQA gathered 152,487 figures, 117,707 tables, and their captions from 25,859 papers with corresponding main text.

question: SPIQA 定义的三个 interleaved image-text 任务分别是什么？
ground_truth: Direct QA with Figures and Tables、Direct QA with Full Paper、CoT QA。
required_facts: Direct QA with Figures and Tables
contexts: SPIQA develops three interleaved image-text tasks: Direct QA with figures and tables; Direct QA with full paper; and CoT QA, where systems first identify helpful figures and then answer the question.

question: SPIQA 自动生成的 QA 总数是多少，过滤后的 test-A 有多少题？
ground_truth: 自动生成 270,194 个 QA；过滤后的 test-A 有 666 题。
contexts: The authors generated 270,194 QAs over 25,859 papers using Gemini 1.5 Pro. After filtering, the final evaluation set contains 666 questions, referred to as test-A.

question: SPIQA 的 test-B 和 test-C 分别从 QASA 与 QASPER 得到多少道题？
ground_truth: test-B 有 228 道，test-C 有 493 道。
contexts: The human-written evaluation sets contain 228 questions from QASA and 493 questions from QASPER; these are referred to as test-B and test-C, respectively.

question: Table 6 中 GPT-4o 在 schematics 与 plots & charts 上的 L3Score 分别是多少？
contexts: Table 6 reports GPT-4o L3Score of 71.38 on schematics and 56.73 on plots & charts.

question: SPIQA 的 Figure 3 说明去掉 captions 对 GPT-4o 的 L3Score 有什么影响？
ground_truth: 去掉 captions 后 GPT-4o 的 L3Score 下降约 2 分。
contexts: Figure 3 shows that all Gemini and GPT variants experience significant performance drops when captions are excluded; GPT-4o suffers a 2-point L3Score decrease on test-A.

question: UDA 覆盖哪些领域，总共有多少篇文档和多少个 expert-annotated QA？
ground_truth: 覆盖 finance、academia 和 world knowledge，共 2,965 篇文档和 29,590 个 expert-annotated QA。
contexts: UDA covers finance, academia, and world knowledge with a total of 2,965 documents and 29,590 expert-annotated Q&A pairs.

contexts: Table 2: PaperTab (PDF) has Doc Num 307 and Q&A Num 393; PaperText (PDF) has Doc Num 1087 and Q&A Num 2804.

contexts: Table 5, Tabular FinHybrid (EM), GPT-4-Turbo: Well Parsed 71.9; GPT-4-Omni 72.4; Raw Text 68.0; CV 61.3; CV + LLM 52.4.

contexts: Table 6, Sparse BM-25 relative LCS: FinHybrid @10 is 87.4 and PaperTab @10 is 90.0.

question: UDA 在结论中明确指出的两个限制是什么？
ground_truth: 没有直接比较解析内容本身的质量；没有深入分析噪声敏感性和幻觉。
required_facts: direct comparison of the parsed content
contexts: UDA limitations: the study did not undertake a direct comparison of the parsed content, and it did not extend to in-depth analyses of noise sensitivity and hallucination.

question: LiveXiv 的主要目标是什么，使用什么类型的论文作为数据来源？
ground_truth: 它旨在缓解测试集污染并真实评估多模态模型，数据来源是科学 ArXiv 论文。
contexts: LiveXiv is proposed to safeguard against test data contamination and to truly test foundation models, using an evolving live benchmark based on scientific ArXiv papers.

question: LiveXiv 的自动数据生成流程中，先用什么工具解析布局，再用什么模型生成和过滤 VQA？
ground_truth: 用 DeepSearch 解析布局，用 GPT-4o 生成 VQA，再由 Llama-3.1-70B 的 blind test 和 Claude-Sonnet agreement 过滤。
contexts: LiveXiv uses the DeepSearch toolkit to extract document layout; GPT-4o generates VQA; Llama-3.1-70B performs the blind test without images; Claude-Sonnet checks agreement with the generated answer and visual context.

question: LiveXiv 的 blind test 会移除大约多少比例的生成问题？
contexts: Questions that are consistently answered correctly by Llama-3.1-70B without visual context are filtered out, resulting in the removal of approximately 30% of the generated questions.

question: LiveXiv v1 与人工验证子集相比，Table 2 给出的 VQA 和 TQA 平均绝对变化分别是多少？
contexts: Table 2 reports the average absolute change between LiveXiv v1 and the manually verified subset: VQA 2.336 and TQA 2.105.

question: Table 3 中所有评估模型在 VQA 的 Arithmetic 和 Block Diagram 类别上的平均准确率分别是多少？
contexts: Table 3: averaged VQA accuracy is 46.87 for Arithmetic and 52.69 for Block Diagram.

question: LiveXiv v1 的人工复核子集包含多少个样本，VQA 与 TQA 各多少个？平均结果变化约是多少？
ground_truth: 共 1,000 个样本，VQA 和 TQA 各 500 个；与全量结果相比平均变化分别为 2.3% 和 2.1%。
contexts: The authors manually verified a subset of 1000 samples, 500 for VQA and 500 for TQA. The average performance fluctuation was 2.3% for VQA and 2.1% for TQA.

question: LiveXiv 的高效评估方法在新版本中通常只需重新评估多少个模型，并可节省超过多少评估量？
ground_truth: 通常重新评估 3 或 5 个模型，可节省超过 70% 的评估量。
contexts: The efficient evaluation experiments suggest that re-evaluating just 3 or 5 models is generally sufficient; the method can save more than 70% of the evaluated models on each dataset version.
